gen_struggle_0_ending_dominance_decision = {
	decision_group_type = major
	title = gen_struggle_0_ending_dominance_decision
	picture = { reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_found_kingdom.dds" }
	extra_picture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/struggle_decision_buttons/fp2_decision_hostility.dds"
	desc = gen_struggle_0_ending_dominance_decision_desc
	selection_tooltip = gen_struggle_0_ending_dominance_decision_tooltip
	is_invisible = yes
	sort_order = 80
	cooldown = { days = 1 }

	is_shown = {
		is_landless_adventurer = no
		exists = struggle:gen_struggle_0
		any_character_struggle = {
			involvement = involved
			is_struggle_type = gen_struggle_0
		}
	}

	is_valid = {
		top_liege = this
		exists = struggle:gen_struggle_0
		prestige_level >= high_prestige_level

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = gen_struggle_0_ending_dominance_decision_phase_tt
			OR = {
				struggle:gen_struggle_0 = { is_struggle_phase = gen_struggle_0_phase_bloodshed }
				completely_controls_region = gen_struggle_region_0
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = gen_struggle_0_ending_dominance_decision_hold_tt
			any_county_in_region = {
				region = gen_struggle_region_0
				percent >= 0.5
				holder.top_liege = root
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = gen_struggle_0_ending_dominance_decision_rivals_tt
			struggle:gen_struggle_0 = {
				NOT = {
					any_involved_ruler = {
						exists = primary_title
						this != root
						top_liege = this
						primary_title = { is_mercenary_company = no }
						any_county_in_region = {
							region = gen_struggle_region_0
							percent > 0.25
							holder.top_liege = prev
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

	}

	effect = {
		add_prestige_level = 1
		dynasty = { add_dynasty_prestige = 5000 }
		add_dread = 25
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = gen_struggle_ending_dominance }
		every_county_in_region = {
			region = gen_struggle_region_0
			limit = { exists = holder holder.top_liege = root }
			add_county_modifier = {
				modifier = gen_struggle_aftermath_dominance
				years = 25
			}
		}
		every_county_in_region = {
			region = gen_struggle_region_0
			limit = { exists = holder NOT = { holder.top_liege = root } }
			add_county_modifier = {
				modifier = gen_struggle_settlement_dominance
				years = 25
			}
		}
		gen_chr_gen_struggle_0_end_dominance_effect = yes
		struggle:gen_struggle_0 = { end_struggle = gen_struggle_0_ending_dominance_decision }
	}

	cost = {}

	ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
		barony = 0
		county = 0
		duchy = 0
		kingdom = 120
		empire = 120
		hegemony = 120
	}

	ai_potential = { always = yes }
	ai_will_do = { base = 100 }

		every_county_in_region = {
			region = gen_struggle_region_1
			limit = { exists = holder NOT = { holder.top_liege = root } }
			add_county_modifier = {
				modifier = gen_struggle_settlement_concord
				years = 60
			}
		}
		gen_chr_gen_struggle_1_end_concord_effect = yes
		struggle:gen_struggle_1 = { end_struggle = gen_struggle_1_ending_concord_decision }
	}

	cost = {}

	ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
		barony = 0
		county = 0
		duchy = 0
		kingdom = 120
		empire = 120
		hegemony = 120
	}

	ai_potential = { always = yes }
	ai_will_do = { base = 100 }
}

gen_struggle_1_ending_foothold_decision = {
	decision_group_type = struggle
	title = gen_struggle_1_ending_foothold_decision
	picture = { reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_destiny_goal.dds" }
	desc = gen_struggle_1_ending_foothold_decision_desc
	selection_tooltip = gen_struggle_1_ending_foothold_decision_tooltip
	sort_order = 80
	cooldown = { days = 1 }

	is_shown = {
		is_landless_adventurer = no
		exists = struggle:gen_struggle_1
		NOT = {
			any_character_struggle = {
				involvement = involved
				is_struggle_type = gen_struggle_1
			}
		}
		any_county_in_region = {
			region = gen_struggle_region_1
			holder.top_liege = root
		}
	}

	is_valid = {
		top_liege = this
		exists = struggle:gen_struggle_1
		prestige_level >= high_prestige_level

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = gen_struggle_1_ending_foothold_decision_phase_tt
			OR = {
				struggle:gen_struggle_1 = { is_struggle_phase = gen_struggle_1_phase_bloodshed }
				struggle:gen_struggle_1 = { is_struggle_phase = gen_struggle_1_phase_ambition }
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = gen_struggle_1_ending_foothold_decision_outsider_tt
			NOT = {
				capital_province = {
					geographical_region = gen_struggle_region_1
				}
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = gen_struggle_1_ending_foothold_decision_hold_tt
			any_county_in_region = {
				region = gen_struggle_region_1
				percent >= 0.33
				holder.top_liege = root
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = gen_struggle_1_ending_foothold_decision_seat_tt
			any_held_title = {
				tier = tier_duchy
				de_jure_liege = title:k_gen_supha_11477
				root = { completely_controls = prev }
				title_held_years >= 15
			}
		}

	}

	effect = {
		add_prestige_level = 1
		dynasty = { add_dynasty_prestige = 5000 }
		add_dread = 25
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = gen_struggle_ending_foothold }
		every_county_in_region = {
			region = gen_struggle_region_1
			limit = { exists = holder holder.top_liege = root }
			add_county_modifier = {
				modifier = gen_struggle_aftermath_foothold
				years = 15
			}
		}
		every_county_in_region = {
			region = gen_struggle_region_1
			limit = { exists = holder NOT = { holder.top_liege = root } }
			add_county_modifier = {
				modifier = gen_struggle_settlement_foothold
				years = 15
			}
		}
		gen_chr_gen_struggle_1_end_foothold_effect = yes
		struggle:gen_struggle_1 = { end_struggle = gen_struggle_1_ending_foothold_decision }
	}

	cost = {}

	ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
		barony = 0
		county = 0
		duchy = 0
		kingdom = 120
		empire = 120
		hegemony = 120
	}

	ai_potential = { always = yes }
	ai_will_do = { base = 100 }
}
